subcategory_text: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 6.1.1, Clause 6.1.3, Annex A.5.1, Annex A.5.19
CRI Profile v2.0: GV.RM-05, GV.RM-05.01, GV.RM-05.02
implementation_examples: Determine how to update senior executives, directors, and management on the organization's cybersecurity posture at agreed-upon intervals

Identify how all departments across the organization - such as management, operations, internal auditors, legal, acquisition, physical security, and HR - will communicate with each other about cybersecurity risks
assessment_objectives: Determine whether lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that determine how to update senior executives, directors, and management on the organization's cybersecurity posture at agreed-upon intervals.

Determine whether activities are conducted to identify how all departments across the organization - such as management, operations, internal auditors, legal, acquisition, physical security, and HR - will communicate with each other about cybersecurity risks.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
